prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent painted prince animation outfit replacement sheet for a preschool timer.
Input image: the referenced prince atlas is the EDIT TARGET and identity/style reference.
Primary request: make his outfit unmistakably a BOY PRINCE IN FULL-LENGTH TROUSERS. Remove the skirt-like blue flared tunic peplum completely. Replace it with a fitted short blue embroidered vest/jacket ending exactly at the brown waist belt. Below the belt show cream long trousers with a clear crotch seam and two separate legs all the way to the brown ankle boots. NO skirt, NO kilt, NO shorts, NO coat tails or blue panels below the belt. Keep the exact same warm watercolor/gouache storybook brushwork, face, chestnut hair, gold crown, cream collar/sleeves, blue-and-gold embroidery, cape and brown boots.
Output composition: a new transparent LANDSCAPE sheet of exactly THREE isolated assets arranged left-to-right in THREE evenly sized cells, clear transparent gutters, no labels or ground. Cell 1: ARM-FREE torso only, from collar/neck opening through the fitted blue vest and brown belt into a short cream trouser pelvis/hip section with a clear center crotch split. Absolutely no head, arms, hands, long leg shafts or boots in this torso piece. Preserve the original torso's shoulder width and shoulder-to-belt proportions; the vest must end at the belt, the cream pelvis fills the old blue flared hem region. Hip section has two rounded trouser leg attachment stubs designed to overlap moving thigh pieces. Cell 2: full assembled SAME prince standing relaxed, both long trouser legs straight and separated, both boots on same baseline. Cell 3: full assembled SAME prince celebrating with both hands outward and up, both hands fully visible, both long trouser legs straight and separated. Full crown and boots visible in cells2/3.
Critical: trousers clearly start at the waist directly below belt, no dress-like silhouette. No additional accessories, no text, no props, no background, genuine transparent alpha. Every cell fully contained with generous transparent margins. Keep the original prince's identity and warm painted style exactly.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: image 1, the new three-cell long-trouser prince sheet. Supporting reference: image 2, original atlas, whose top-row second torso piece is properly ARM-FREE.
Change ONLY the first cell torso cutout: completely remove both cream puff sleeves, cuffs and every attached arm stump. Leave clean blue vest armholes and shoulder edges matching the armless torso construction of image2. Keep collar, blue vest, brown waist belt. SHORTEN the cream lower section drastically: it is only a shallow hip/waist cap just underneath the belt, ending at the crotch seam with two short rounded attachment roots. No fixed thigh shafts and no shorts. That small cap will overlap independently animated long trouser legs. Keep the torso shoulders and chest proportion the same as now. Do NOT add blue flared panels below the belt.
Do not change the assembled standing and celebrating LONG-TROUSER princes in cells2/3 at all. Keep canvas size, positions of all cells, transparency, painted brushwork and colors. No head/arms/legs in cell1 torso, no background, no text. Genuine transparent alpha.
